text:
maria: heads-up — we're seeing a bursty rash of `dedicated-gpu-node:gpu_utilization` alerts overnight (around 02:00-04:00 UTC) that look like batch job ramp-ups, not steady production load. firing ~10x in the last 3 nights. grafana: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/ops/gpu-cluster?orgId=1&panelId=7 :eyes:
oncall-bot: (auto) 12 alerts in the last 6h for dedicated-gpu-node cluster

sanjay: ack. are these valid capacity issues or just noisy spikes? can you paste the alert rule?

maria: mostly spikes — pods recover in <3m and throughput unaffected. current alert rule (from prometheus-alerts repo):
```yaml
alert: GPUHighUtilization
expr: avg_over_time(gpu_utilization[5m]) > 0.85
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "GPU util >85% on dedicated pool"
```

olivia: thanks. two quick options: raise threshold to 0.92 or increase `for` to 10m, or add a `max_over_time` suppression for short spikes. raising threshold avoids pages but risks missing sustained climbs.

tim: +1 to changing to `for: 10m` and add a mute window for the nightly batch. can we mute 02:00-04:30 UTC weekdays? that should cover the noise without masking real incidents. @oncall-bot will this pass policy?

oncall-bot: muted windows require approval from eng-sre leads. please file a short PR to `infra/alert-config` and tag @olivia for review.

alerts-bot: FYI — rules change will affect historical alerting in Alerting Dashboard (link: https://alerts.redwood.company/rules/).

maria: filed PR #412 in infra/alert-config with proposed change (diff below). request review from @olivia @tim — rolling to canary after merge.
```diff
- alert: GPUHighUtilization
- expr: avg_over_time(gpu_utilization[5m]) > 0.85
- for: 5m
+ alert: GPUHighUtilization
+ expr: avg_over_time(gpu_utilization[10m]) > 0.92
+ for: 10m
```

olivia: quick nit: use `avg_over_time(...[10m]) > 0.9` to be slightly safer, and add annotation `runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.company/gpu-high`

sanjay: can we also add `severity: high` -> `severity: prod` to avoid paging infra-oncall? or leave as `page` if you're confident?

tim: leave as `page` for now, but add `escalation: oncall` annotation. if the change looks good @olivia please approve so we can merge and schedule mute window.

olivia: approved. will merge and push a canary ramp for 2h. maria — please monitor post-merge and update the thread if we still see noise. :thumbsup:

maria: will watch and report back tomorrow morning. thanks all!
